qualifier: downstream of mitochondrial apoptotic factor release
name: Apoptosome-mediated caspase activation after mitochondrial factor release
rationale: All three members cover cytochrome c/apoptotic factor release and apoptosome-driven caspase activation, whereas the confusables cover the upstream BCL-2 family/BH3-only control of outer membrane permeabilization.

core: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell regulation
qualifier: stem cell maintenance and bone marrow homeostasis
name: Hematopoietic stem cell maintenance and bone marrow homeostasis
rationale: Members concern HSC proliferation, division, homeostasis and early progenitor/lineage decisions within the bone marrow, whereas confusables centre on committed myeloid, granulocytic, erythroid and megakaryocytic differentiation and CSF signaling.

name: Coronavirus replicase translation and host translation modulation
rationale: All members describe SARS-CoV translation and maturation of replicase polyproteins, RTC assembly and hijacking of host translation, distinguishing them from structural protein maturation, genome replication and interferon-response confusables.

name: Phosphatidylserine exposure and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members span calcium-activated phospholipid scrambling, PS exposure, blebbing/cell shrinkage and recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells, whereas confusables cover scavenger receptor uptake, flippase-mediated aminophospholipid translocation and foam cell formation.

qualifier: platelet adhesion and inherited clotting factor defects
name: Coagulation cascade, fibrinolysis and platelet adhesion, including factor defects
rationale: Members cover the coagulation cascade, fibrin formation and fibrinolysis, VWF/GPIb/GPVI-mediated platelet adhesion and many F8, F9, FV, FXII and VWF disease variants, which the confusables (platelet GPCR agonist and integrin signaling) lack.

qualifier: histone and DNA methylation, acetylation and BAF remodeling complexes
name: Histone and DNA modification and chromatin remodeling complexes
rationale: Members are histone/protein methylation and acetylation, DNA methylation, imprinting and X inactivation, and BAF/CHD/NuRD remodeling complexes, distinguishing them from confusables about SUMOylation of chromatin proteins, nucleosome assembly and retroelement silencing.

name: Nascent HDL assembly via ABCA1 and apolipoprotein A-I
rationale: All members concern formation of nascent HDL by ABCA1-mediated cholesterol loading of apoA-I and the associated signaling, whereas confusables cover cholesterol efflux regulation, foam cell formation and HDL/LDL remodeling.

qualifier: receptor activation through TCF target regulation
name: Canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signaling from receptor to TCF targets
rationale: Members span FZD/LRP5/RNF43 receptor regulation, DVL activation, AXIN and destruction complex disassembly and TCF/LEF target activation or repression, unlike the confusable focused on destruction-complex phosphorylation mutants and the Notch confusables.

name: Kidney nephron, ureteric bud and glomerulus development
rationale: Nearly all members concern nephric duct, ureteric bud, nephron tubule and glomerular development and function, distinguishing the theme from lung, mammary, prostate and salivary branching morphogenesis confusables.

core: DNA polymerase synthesis and gap filling
qualifier: base excision repair and error-prone translesion synthesis
name: DNA synthesis in replication, base excision repair and translesion bypass
rationale: Members share PCNA-associated DNA polymerase synthesis steps (polymerase switching, flap removal, long-patch BER gap filling, error-prone TLS by REV1/POLI/POLK, somatic hypermutation), whereas confusables cover NER incision and error-free POLH bypass.

qualifier: TNF-family/NF-kappaB signaling defects causing ectodermal dysplasia
name: Ectodermal placode development and TNF-NF-kappaB ectodermal dysplasia
rationale: Members link TNF-family ligand-receptor and NF-kappaB (IKBKG, IkBA) signaling defects causing anhidrotic ectodermal dysplasia with ectodermal differentiation and hair placode formation, unlike the tooth and hair-cycle confusables.

name: Vitamin D metabolism and hydroxylase deficiency disorders
rationale: All members concern vitamin D3 activation/catabolism and receptor signaling, including CYP27B1 and CYP24A1 disease variants, distinguishing them from phosphate transport, vitamin K and bone mineralization confusables.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I and III transcription
name: RNA polymerase I/III transcription, ribosome biogenesis and translation initiation
rationale: Members cover Pol I rRNA and Pol III tRNA/5S transcription, pre-rRNA cleavage, ribosome assembly, translation initiation and MYC growth targets, whereas confusables emphasise RNA decay/modification, Pol II/HIV transcription and splicing.

name: HSF1 heat shock response regulation and protein acetylation
rationale: Members combine HSF1 activation, attenuation and heat acclimation with protein acetylation and redox state, distinguishing the theme from mitochondrial UPR/refolding, stress granule and histone acetylation confusables.

name: Platelet GPCR agonist signaling and degranulation
rationale: Members are platelet activation through thrombin PAR, ADP P2Y1/P2Y12, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptors with degranulation and cytoskeletal remodeling, whereas confusables cover VWF/GPIb and GPVI adhesion, coagulation and Rap1/integrin signaling.

name: Circadian bHLH-PAS transcription and pancreatic secretory regulation
rationale: Members tie CLOCK/BMAL1/NPAS2 and NPAS4 transcription to locomotor rhythm, beta-cell proliferation and development, pancreatic juice secretion and lactation, a loose grouping of clock-controlled physiology that the gluconeogenesis, sleep and nuclear-receptor confusables lack.

qualifier: GLUT4 glucose uptake and glycogen synthesis
name: Insulin signaling to GLUT4 glucose uptake and glycogen synthesis
rationale: Members cover insulin receptor/IRS/AKT2 signaling, receptor recycling and attenuation, GLUT4 translocation, glucose import and glycogen synthesis, distinguishing peripheral insulin action from the insulin secretion and glucokinase confusables.

name: RAC-subfamily GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are the RAC1, RAC2, RAC3 and RHOG GTPase cycles plus generic small GTPase and G beta:gamma-CDC42 signaling, whereas confusables cover CDC42/RHOJ, RHOA-D cycles and downstream WAVE/Arp2/3 effectors.

qualifier: osteoblast development, direct ossification and joint morphogenesis
name: Osteoblast development, direct ossification and skeletal joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover RUNX2-driven osteoblast development, intramembranous ossification, trabecula and cranial suture formation and joint/tendon morphogenesis, distinguishing them from chondrocyte maturation and osteoblast proliferation-regulation confusables.

qualifier: KIR and MHC class Ib recognition
name: NK cell regulation via KIR and MHC class Ib recognition
rationale: Members address NK cell degranulation, cytokine production and inhibition, protection from NK cytotoxicity, KIR-cluster signatures and MHC class Ib presentation, whereas confusables emphasise positive NK/T cell cytotoxicity and T cell activation.

qualifier: transcriptional programmes including thymocyte and lineage differentiation
name: T cell activation and differentiation transcriptional programmes
rationale: Members are T cell activation/signaling gene signatures and T, CD8 and gamma-delta T cell differentiation, distinguishing them from confusables about proximal TCR/CD28 signaling events and thymic selection.

name: Magnesium ion transport and protein oligomerization
rationale: Members combine magnesium transport and response to magnesium with protein tetramerization and hexamerization (consistent with oligomeric Mg2+ channels), distinguishing them from tight junction, inositol, chloride cotransporter and creatine confusables.

name: Proton-coupled monocarboxylate and organic ion transport
rationale: Members cover SLC16/basigin lactate and pyruvate transport, alpha-ketoglutarate and dicarboxylate transport and organic cation/anion transport, whereas confusables emphasise carnitine/choline metabolism, succinate/TCA intermediate transport and the malate-aspartate shuttle.

core: Bile acid metabolism and intestinal lipid absorption
name: Bile acid metabolism, intestinal lipid absorption and lipoprotein assembly
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis, transport, recycling and signaling, sterol transporter (ABCB11, ABCB4, ABCG5/8) defects, dietary lipid digestion and chylomicron/VLDL assembly, unlike confusables on xenobiotic/bilirubin handling and lipoprotein remodeling, clearance and cholesterol efflux.

name: Lung branching, mesenchyme and trachea development
rationale: All members concern lung bud branching, lung mesenchyme proliferation, lobe, vasculature and trachea development, distinguishing them from salivary/limb bud and alveolar saccule/pneumocyte confusables.
